item.title: SCHMEICHEL: ‘NO BIG DECISION,’ ADMITS CELTIC BOSS
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL has admitted it was no “big decision” to play Kasper Schmeichel against Hibs at Parkhead yesterday. The Danish legend was blameless as the Edinburgh side won 2-1 to claim their first victory at the venue in 16 years. item.title: SFA review process adheres
item.description: If the SFA today uphold the red card given for violent conduct against Auston Trusty on Sunday, we have verification of what we will face between now and the end of the season.
